cards.back:
Instructions that tell you how to cook something.
Bahasa Indonesia: resep
Example: We followed the recipe to make a cake.
cards.say: recipe. Instructions that tell you how to cook something. We followed the recipe to make a cake.

cards.back:
One of the foods you use to make a dish.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahan
Example: Flour is the main ingredient in bread.
cards.say: ingredient. One of the foods you use to make a dish. Flour is the main ingredient in bread.

cards.back:
To cook food in an oven.
Bahasa Indonesia: memanggang
Example: We bake bread every Sunday morning.
cards.say: bake. To cook food in an oven. We bake bread every Sunday morning.

cards.back:
To heat water until it bubbles.
Bahasa Indonesia: merebus
Example: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
cards.say: boil. To heat water until it bubbles. Boil the eggs for ten minutes.

cards.back:
To cook food in hot oil.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggoreng
Example: Dad will fry some rice for dinner.
cards.say: fry. To cook food in hot oil. Dad will fry some rice for dinner.

cards.back:
To cut something into thin, flat pieces.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengiris
Example: Please slice the tomato for the salad.
cards.say: slice. To cut something into thin, flat pieces. Please slice the tomato for the salad.

cards.back:
To cut food into small pieces.
Bahasa Indonesia: memotong kecil-kecil
Example: She will chop the onions with a knife.
cards.say: chop. To cut food into small pieces. She will chop the onions with a knife.

cards.back:
To move food around in a pot with a spoon.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengaduk
Example: Stir the soup so it does not burn.
cards.say: stir. To move food around in a pot with a spoon. Stir the soup so it does not burn.

cards.back:
To put things together so they become one.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencampur
Example: Mix the eggs and sugar in a bowl.
cards.say: mix. To put things together so they become one. Mix the eggs and sugar in a bowl.

cards.back:
To make a liquid flow out of a container.
Bahasa Indonesia: menuangkan
Example: Pour the milk into my glass, please.
cards.say: pour. To make a liquid flow out of a container. Pour the milk into my glass, please.

cards.back:
To take the skin off a fruit or vegetable.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengupas
Example: I peel an orange before I eat it.
cards.say: peel. To take the skin off a fruit or vegetable. I peel an orange before I eat it.

cards.back:
A hot box in the kitchen for baking food.
Bahasa Indonesia: oven
Example: The cake is in the oven now.
cards.say: oven. A hot box in the kitchen for baking food. The cake is in the oven now.

cards.back:
A deep round dish for soup or cereal.
Bahasa Indonesia: mangkuk
Example: He ate a big bowl of noodles.
cards.say: bowl. A deep round dish for soup or cereal. He ate a big bowl of noodles.

cards.back:
A tool with a small round end for eating or stirring.
Bahasa Indonesia: sendok
Example: Use a spoon to eat the ice cream.
cards.say: spoon. A tool with a small round end for eating or stirring. Use a spoon to eat the ice cream.

cards.back:
A tool with points that you use to lift food.
Bahasa Indonesia: garpu
Example: She picked up the pasta with a fork.
cards.say: fork. A tool with points that you use to lift food. She picked up the pasta with a fork.

cards.back:
A flat dish that you eat from.
Bahasa Indonesia: piring
Example: Put the rice on my plate, please.
cards.say: plate. A flat dish that you eat from. Put the rice on my plate, please.

cards.back:
A soft powder made from wheat, used to bake.
Bahasa Indonesia: tepung
Example: We need two cups of flour for the bread.
cards.say: flour. A soft powder made from wheat, used to bake. We need two cups of flour for the bread.

cards.back:
A sweet white powder that makes drinks and cakes sweet.
Bahasa Indonesia: gula
Example: I do not put sugar in my tea.
cards.say: sugar. A sweet white powder that makes drinks and cakes sweet. I do not put sugar in my tea.

cards.back:
A white food that makes dishes taste better.
Bahasa Indonesia: garam
Example: The soup needs a little more salt.
cards.say: salt. A white food that makes dishes taste better. The soup needs a little more salt.

cards.back:
Tasting very good.
Bahasa Indonesia: lezat
Example: Grandma's fried chicken tastes really delicious.
cards.say: delicious. Tasting very good. Grandma's fried chicken tastes really delicious.

cards.back:
Wanting to eat food.
Bahasa Indonesia: lapar
Example: I am hungry because I skipped breakfast.
cards.say: hungry. Wanting to eat food. I am hungry because I skipped breakfast.

cards.back:
Wanting to drink something.
Bahasa Indonesia: haus
Example: We were thirsty after the football match.
cards.say: thirsty. Wanting to drink something. We were thirsty after the football match.
